import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n;
    static char[] s;
    static long[][] comb;
    static int[] cnt_a, cnt_b;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] partial, partial_zero;

    static void computeComb() {
        comb = new long[n+1][n+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j];
        }
    }

    static long getDifs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                ++b_bef;
                long aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                long aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                ++a_bef;
                long aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                long aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) != 0) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void computeSecondPart() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        partial = new ArrayList[c+2];
        partial_zero = new ArrayList[c+2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= c+1; ++i) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partial_zero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; ++conf) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            long val = getDifs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here);
            if (check(conf))
                partial[a_here].add(val);
            else
                partial_zero[a_here].add(val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partial_zero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long getCoef(int conf) {
        int i, j;
        for (i = 0; i < c + 1; ++i)
            if (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))
                break;
        for (j = i; j < c + 1; ++j) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && ((conf >> j) & 1) != 0) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && ((conf >> j) & 1) == 0) return 0;
        }
        int set_a = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + ((conf & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);
        if (set_a < cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return comb[set_a + set_b - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i] - cnt_b[2 * r - 2 + i]][set_a - cnt_a[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void upd(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] < act[0]) return;
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
            return;
        }
        ans[1] += act[1];
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Long> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    static int upperBound(ArrayList<Long> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) <= key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    static long howMany(ArrayList<Long> list, long val) {
        return upperBound(list, val) - lowerBound(list, val);
    }

    static long computeFirstPart() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] ans = new long[]{1L << 60, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; ++conf) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            long act = getDifs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = getCoef(conf);
            ArrayList<Long> list = partial[c + 1 - a_here]; // same as partial[b_here]
            int idx = lowerBound(list, -act);
            if (idx < list.size()) {
                long val = list.get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = howMany(list, val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = list.get(idx - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = howMany(list, val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            }
            coef = 0;
            list = partial_zero[c + 1 - a_here];
            idx = lowerBound(list, -act);
            if (idx < list.size()) {
                long val = list.get(idx);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = howMany(list, val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = list.get(idx - 1);
                if (ans[0] >= Math.abs(val + act)) {
                    long cnt = howMany(list, val);
                    upd(ans, new long[]{val + act, coef * cnt});
                }
            }
        }
        return ans[1];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        r = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        String sLine = sc.nextLine();
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        s = new char[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) s[i] = sLine.charAt(i - 1);
        computeComb();
        cnt_a = new int[n + 1];
        cnt_b = new int[n + 1];
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            cnt_a[i] = cnt_a[i-1] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cnt_b[i] = cnt_b[i-1] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        computeSecondPart();
        long sol = computeFirstPart();
        System.out.println(sol);
    }
}
